title: SimUSER: Simulating User Behavior with Large Language Models for Recommender System Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the rating and sentiment distributions generated by LLM-powered user agents against human ground truth (e.g., IMDB reviews) to measure the inherent tendency of LLMs to output overly positive opinions and ratings.

Simulating a scenario where the recommender system provides skewed recommendations restricted to only two genres (action and horror) and measuring if the agents' subsequent ratings for over-represented categories artificially increase over time (exposure effect).
